verdict.rationale: Capacities documents its own developer surface. It has a REST API for accessing, creating and manipulating content, with Bearer token auth, an OpenAPI 3.0 spec and an interactive try-it reference. It also offers MCP integration for custom apps, agents or bots, and a successor developer portal covering SDKs with TypeScript SDK samples. These let developers build external integrations, but nothing in the evidence shows an in-app plugin or extension runtime that extends the Capacities UI, so the core 'plugin' part of the story is unproven, and the current Beta API is scheduled for deprecation. Missing for 10: an in-app plugin/extension API, plugin samples and a plugin developer guide, a plugin distribution or loading mechanism, and independent corroboration that developers build plugins.
